correctness.rationale: For odd p^k and unit lambda,mu the ordered additive collision energy equals sum_(s,t) D_lambda(s,t)D_mu(s,t), origin phi(p^k)^2, with nonzero difference fibers restricted to matching p-adic valuations. Positive equal-valuation shell h contributes (p−1)^2 p^(2k−2)(1+chi). In unit (s,t) coordinates the quadratic root count yields N_k=p^(k−1)(p−4−chi) for v_p(lambda−mu)=0 by smooth Hensel lifting and quadratic character sums. For v>=1, the only singular mod-p branch becomes AB=−epsilon with A,B multiples of p; classifying valuations yields N_k=p^(k−1)[2p−6+(v−1)(p−1)+1_(v=k)], and chi=1. Assembling shell and unit terms proves both explicit displayed local formulas, including p=3 and k=1; CRT gives every odd N and Fourier orthogonality gives q² times mixed fourth moment. Independently evaluated 1027 parameter cases by direct ordered difference-fiber convolution, not the quadratic-root method.
residual_risks: Requires odd N and unit parameters. Mixed full-frequency fourth moment is not a fixed-frequency or incomplete-interval moment; nonunit/2-adic cases excluded.
